scope: The owner's full-FEI-only priority for the existing covered schedules. Preserve native identities, existing A001-A100 packet ownership, cadence, end dates and canonical mathematics; apply these targets within the live selected packet.
ultimate_target: There exists an absolute C such that H(hat f^2)<=C I(f) for every Boolean sign function f on every finite uniform cube. A genuine rigorous counterexample family would also settle the question.
global_rules: Each run does mathematics directed at full FEI: derive a new inequality, remove one substantive hypothesis, grow an all-parameter class, falsify a proposed universal mechanism, or independently audit the active proof step. Publication polish and unrelated projects are outside this overlay.
Begin from the latest source-complete result and exact surviving gap; do not repeat a completed local constant optimization, known class proof, saved counterexample, or equivalence as new progress.
Choose one primary mathematical proposition per run with exact quantifiers, units, normalization, class assumptions and constants. State which parameter still prevents universality.

Use genuine Boolean functions and physical Fourier coefficients. A free probability law, arbitrary real rows, incoherent mixture or unproved realizability constraint cannot substitute for Boolean spectra.

Uniform-cube H,U,B use bits. For product FEI+, declare sigma_i^2=4q_i(1-q_i), E=sum_{S nonempty}hat f_mu(S)^2 ln(sigma_S^2/hat f_mu(S)^2) in nats, H_mu^+=E/ln2, and Delta_mu=I_mu-Var_mu. Do not replace corrected entropy by ordinary Shannon entropy.

All adaptive, composition and overlap arguments must retain coherent sums, terminal entropy/influence and actual physical-coordinate ownership. Do not spend overlapping ledgers twice or recharge a whole subtree once per ancestor.

Evidence from a finite domain stays EVIDENCE or a finite certificate. PROVED refers only to the written theorem's exact scope; author proof and independent review are separate fields. Refuting an auxiliary inequality is not refuting FEI.

Treat U<=KI, good-coordinate/stopping-tree formulations, unrestricted selector closure, all-prime product FEI+ and a uniform K_k bound as universal-equivalent or universal-sufficient targets, not already solved reductions.

For a new class theorem, give a strict new all-parameter family and an explicit next hypothesis removal. Track whether the constant remains bounded as address count, overlap, depth, arity or bias degeneracy grows.
Primary-source lookup is targeted to the active lemma and priority claim. Read source statements and versions; do not rely on titles, internal claim labels or outdated numerical lower bounds.

Every output records target, source pins, complete proof or first unsupported line, exact surviving universal gap, meaningful verification, status and next cross-stream handoff. Do not claim full FEI from a proper class.
